question.text: Dakshin Capital Cat II AIF: Committed INR 200 cr. Set-up cost 2.5% of commitments (INR 5 crore, amortised over 5 yr full tenure). Mgmt fee 2% on commitments Y1 (excl. GST @18%). Yearly operating expenses INR 80 lakh. Compute TOTAL Year-1 fee+expense outflow (including GST on mgmt fee).

explanation.text: The Logic: Set-up amortisation Y1 = INR 5 / 5 = INR 1.00 cr. Mgmt fee pre-GST = 2% x 200 cr = INR 4.00 cr. GST @ 18% on mgmt fee = INR 0.72 cr. Operating expense = INR 0.80 cr. Total Year-1 outflow = 1.00 + 4.00 + 0.72 + 0.80 = INR 6.52 crore. This follows the workbook's set-up-amortisation + management-fee-plus-GST + yearly-operating-expense build-up. The Trap: A omits GST, opex and set-up amortisation; B omits the INR 0.80 cr operating expense and is therefore short by exactly that amount; D mis-adds the components. Note: Changed the answer key from B (INR 5.52 cr) to C (INR 6.52 cr); B incorrectly omitted the operating-expense line, which the source on pp.115 and 118-119 requires to be deducted yearly. Removed the consolidated fee-waterfall PPM pro-tip and the Cross-Exam Context paragraph as broader than the source.
